findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "certify_executive_credential_seal" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Verifies SHA-256 cryptographic completion seals on Harlington executive credentials in p95 70 ms (0,08 EUR, 100% deterministic).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
